description: End-to-end packaging design ordering, prepress technical validation, variant tracking, and print-ready certification for box, pouch, label, cup, sleeve, food, and cosmetic packaging.

routesToMount.note: Mount after creativeMarketplaceRouter. Router self-registers /ai/packaging-design/* (admin) and /public/packaging-design/* (public) prefixes.

pagesToRegister.note: Add lazy import after CpReviewPage. Add Route before the NotFound catch-all.
Add import after CreativeMarketplace. Add Route inside AdminRouter before the NotFound fallback.

schemaExportsRequested.note: Domain-local schema defines all three tables using pgSchema('ai_platform') locally. If Team 24 decides to centralise schema for cross-domain queries, copy schema.ts content into lib/db/src/schema/packaging-design.ts and add 'export * from "./packaging-design"' to index.ts.

dependencyRequests.note: Already a direct dependency of artifacts/api-server.

integrationNotes: Admin routes require x-admin-api-key (handled by global adminAuthWithExceptions middleware — no per-route duplication needed).
Public routes /public/packaging-design/* do NOT require auth — customer-facing submission and UUID order tracking.
Migration draft at integration/migrations/team-19.sql — additive only, no DROP/TRUNCATE, all IF NOT EXISTS.
print_ready status gate is enforced in updateOrderStatus(): blocked unless prepressValidationJson.blockerCount === 0 AND all active variants have consistencyStatus === 'consistent'.
Regulated service types (food_packaging, cosmetic_packaging, bottle_label, jar_label) require hasIngredientsBlock AND hasLegalBlock — enforced at both submit (public route) and prepress validation.
invariants: print_ready status MUST NOT be set before prepress validation passes with zero error-severity blockers
Regulated service types MUST have hasIngredientsBlock AND hasLegalBlock
Barcode zone MUST NOT overlap bleed or safe-area margins
All active variants MUST pass consistency validation before print_ready
